scope.optional_screen_sources: first 300 registered calibration IDs; screen receipts are not deployable

profile_interface.bundle: list of profiles, or object with profiles list
profile_interface.full_next_scale: normalize K=L to (m+1,0) before optimizer; no duplicate endpoint
profile_interface.physical_config_deduplication: phy_key includes actual coding/rate-matching/layout/modulation identity, not just nominal rate
profile_interface.wire_deduplication: wire_key identifies identical actual complete packet layouts across nominal candidate labels; final deployment codebook assigns profile IDs separately
profile_interface.not_feasible: profiles marked NOT_FEASIBLE or feasible=false are listed as excluded, never interpolated

quality_interface.gray: one state_id=gray,receiver=gray row per calibration source, shared by both receivers
quality_interface.complete_grid: all feasible full/prefix states and gray for all required sources; missing quality fails admission
quality_interface.additional_metric_columns: retained upstream but not read by policy selection
quality_interface.direct_partial_definition: received true embeddings, zero embedding at missing positions, missing complete scales absent; never token index zero as a substitute

probability_interface.source_id: exact calibration source ID overrides wildcard '*' for that source; stratified estimates must first expand to their registered source IDs
probability_interface.probability_definition: correct decode, rejected, accepted-but-wrong are disjoint; their probabilities sum to one
probability_interface.counts: if any count is supplied, all four integer counts are required and must exactly generate the reported probabilities
probability_interface.interval: optional two-sided p_correct interval; correct success probability, not CRC acceptance probability
probability_interface.refinement_stopping: 100 block errors (reject plus undetected) or 20000 blocks, whichever first; intervals retained at cap
probability_interface.zero_errors: zero observed errors never proves true BLER zero

expectation.aggregation: combine source-specific p and Q first, then arithmetic mean over registered calibration source IDs
expectation.header_probability: correct header probability, with explicit rejected/undetected bookkeeping upstream
expectation.contiguous_prefix: no later group is usable after an earlier group fails; no CRC-failed hard tokens
expectation.approximation: effects of undetected errors are ignored only by this finite-state expectation, retained in real link diagnostics
expectation.interval_propagation: all multilinear probability-box vertices, including nonmonotonic quality; conservative plug-in bounds, not a joint confidence interval
expectation.average_power: Es=2 fixed-constellation normalization for QPSK/16QAM; actual 16QAM energy varies; no strict per-frame equal-energy claim

selection.tie_break: exact equal mean score: fewer groups first, then lexical stable_id
selection.B0: G1, optimize complete endpoint, partial count, modulation and legal protection, including legal full-budget rate matching
selection.B1: G2, common nominal MCS; mcs_id equality or modulation+nominal_rate equality. Actual effective rates may differ after finite-length padding/rate matching
selection.B2: G2, common modulation; protection can differ or coincide
selection.B3: all legal G1/G2 candidates, including B0/B1/B2 degenerations
selection.B4: same full candidate set as B3, maximize direct-receiver quality expectation, then actually receive with VAR
selection.matched_controls: B1/B2/B3 at B3 chosen same(m,K,j), separately from independent optima; NOT_APPLICABLE when B3 G1
selection.strong_baseline: best predicted VAR score among independently selected B0/B1/B2
selection.model_validation_candidate: highest predicted VAR score whose actual wire_key differs from BOTH B3 and the strong baseline, frozen on calibration before development; missing additional distinct layout blocks qualification
selection.top3: all families, including B4 ranked by direct quality
selection.refinement_requirements: deduplicated phy_key/SNR points used by all top3, matched controls, strong baseline and distinct-resource validation candidate
selection.ready_for_actual_link: final full1000 calibration selection, every relevant BLER stratum reached registered stopping criterion, and distinct wire validation candidate exists
selection.direct_affine_invariance: positive affine direct-to-VAR quality transform may leave allocation unchanged; no changed policy is required
selection.prior_awareness_claim: nonnegative predicted argmax difference is mathematical, not evidence; actual VAR-received B3 versus B4 comparison required

independent_metric.definition: indicator: classifier prediction of reconstruction equals classifier prediction of original

development_gate.count: exactly 100 registered development sources x 3 registered noise seeds per method/SNR, including every failure
development_gate.bootstrap: paired B3 minus B0; average three noise realizations within each source before resampling sources
development_gate.interval: two-sided percentile95%, lower bound strictly greater than zero; same draws for both metrics and every SNR
development_gate.extension: at least two of4/7/10/13dB each have strictly positive paired95% lower bounds for BOTH DINO-L and independent ConvNeXt agreement, B3 G2 at those points, AND model validation PASS at all four points
development_gate.failure_action: deliver full positive/negative result, stop extension
